# mcp-mail

> Self-hosted IMAP/SMTP email MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client, with per-client permissions, audit log and one-line install. MIT licensed; a maintained continuation of claude-mail-mcp.

mcp-mail exposes an existing mailbox (any IMAP/SMTP provider, optional CalDAV calendar) to AI agents over the Model Context Protocol, via Streamable HTTP (protocol 2026-07-28 and earlier) or stdio. Each agent gets its own credentials and a permission preset (read-only, read-draft, organize, full-no-delete, full); tools it may not use are hidden and rejected. Email content is fenced as untrusted to reduce prompt injection. An opt-in platform mode adds multi-tenant endpoints, encrypted per-tenant secrets and an admin API.
